title: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 항만지역등 대기질 개선에 관한 특별법 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Designation of Low-Speed Operation Areas)
(1) When the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries intends to designate a low-speed operation area (hereinafter referred to as "low-speed operation area") in accordance with Article 11(1) of the Act, the Minister must consult with the governors and harbor authorities of the relevant area designated for designation.
(2) When the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries designates a low-speed operation area, the location, purpose, operating method, and other necessary matters of the area must be announced.
(3) The "speed as specified in Article 11(1) of the Act" refers to the speed determined and announced by the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries within the range of 12 knots or less.
(4) The owner of a vessel seeking support under Article 11(2) of the Act must submit a low-speed operation vessel confirmation application form (as specified in Annex) along with documents demonstrating compliance with the recommendations under Article 11(1) of the Act to the relevant regional maritime affairs and fisheries office or harbor authority.
